description: ExprDTResolution executions(isMicrosecond) under both engine time resolutions: event-time-ms/us replay ExprDTResolutionEventTime (object-array MyEvent(id,sts,ets) with sts/ets timestamp properties; a.withDate(2002,4,30).before(b) fires iff the shifted end is strictly before b's start — the boundary is one engine unit, 1 ms vs 1 µs), long-property-ms/us replay ExprDTLongProperty (c0..c7 over longdate and current_timestamp: µs long ops preserve the sub-ms remainder, toCalendar/toDate truncate to ms, minus(1) is one millisecond in both modes).

cases.observation: listener+count; advanceTime(0), B@t seeds #lastevent without evaluating (unidirectional), A@flip-1 fires the join row (a,b fragments), A@flip does not — the strict before boundary is 1 ms
cases.epl: @name('s0') select * from MyEvent(id='A') as a unidirectional, MyEvent(id='B')#lastevent as b where a.withDate(2002, 4, 30).before(b)

cases.observation: listener+count; identical shape under the microsecond time source with all timestamps x1000: A@flip-1µs fires, A@flip does not — the strict before boundary is 1 µs
cases.epl: @name('s0') select * from MyEvent(id='A') as a unidirectional, MyEvent(id='B')#lastevent as b where a.withDate(2002, 4, 30).before(b)

cases.observation: listener; advanceTime(t) then one SupportDateTime(longdate=t) send emits c0..c7 = [calModMillis, calMod, 4, 4, 5, calTime, calTime, t-1]
cases.epl: @name('s0') select longdate.withTime(1, 2, 3, 4) as c0,longdate.set('hour', 1).set('minute', 2).set('second', 3).set('millisecond', 4).toCalendar() as c1,longdate.get('month') as c2,current_timestamp.get('month') as c3,current_timestamp.getMinuteOfHour() as c4,current_timestamp.toDate() as c5,current_timestamp.toCalendar() as c6,current_timestamp.minus(1) as c7 from SupportDateTime

cases.observation: listener; advanceTime(t*1000) then SupportDateTime(longdate=t*1000+123) emits c0=calModMillis*1000+123 (µs remainder preserved), c1/c5/c6 truncated to the same ms values as the ms run, c7=t*1000-1000 (minus(1) is one millisecond)
cases.epl: @name('s0') select longdate.withTime(1, 2, 3, 4) as c0,longdate.set('hour', 1).set('minute', 2).set('second', 3).set('millisecond', 4).toCalendar() as c1,longdate.get('month') as c2,current_timestamp.get('month') as c3,current_timestamp.getMinuteOfHour() as c4,current_timestamp.toDate() as c5,current_timestamp.toCalendar() as c6,current_timestamp.minus(1) as c7 from SupportDateTime
